title: Check yourself: Descriptions, names and boundaries: what a model chooses a tool from

questions.stem: Logs show an agent often calls `get_customer` when users ask about orders, instead of `lookup_order`. Each tool has a one-line summary (“Retrieves customer information”, “Retrieves order details”) and accepts similar identifiers. What is the best first step?

options.text: Rewrite both texts with input shapes, sample requests and where each one stops
options.says: The cause is thin descriptions, and the first fix is to make each say what it takes and where it stops.

options.text: Add five to eight worked examples of order requests to the system prompt
options.says: Ruled out because worked examples in the prompt "leave the descriptions as thin as they were" and cost tokens on every request.

options.text: Put a layer before each turn that picks the tool by keywords and id patterns
options.says: Ruled out because "a routing layer bypasses the model's own reading of the request" and is a component to build.

options.text: Merge both into a single `lookup_entity` tool that works out which backend to ask
options.says: Ruled out because merging "is a legitimate design but a larger change than a first step needs".

questions.stem: Since the team added the sentence "Always check the customer's account first." to an agent's prompt, it calls `get_customer` before every order question, although the `lookup_order` description is clear. Which change most directly removes the unwanted pull?

options.text: Add a third tool that wraps both lookups behind one name
options.says: Ruled out because a wrapper adds a third name to choose from, and "More tools don't always lead to better outcomes."

options.text: Add a routing layer in front of the model for order questions
options.says: Ruled out because a routing layer "bypasses the model's own reading of the request" and leaves the prompt as it was.

options.text: Reword that rule to drop its tool-specific trigger
options.says: The keyword in the rule pulls the choice, so the rule is what to change.

options.text: Lengthen the `lookup_order` description with more examples
options.says: Ruled out because the keyword pulls every order question toward `get_customer` "however clear the description of `lookup_order` is"; more text on the other side does not remove the pull.
